Settled week a helpful note for customers
Please read this before you travel
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers need to check pet travel details before departure so the trip runs smoothly and the animal stays as calm as possible.

Aurelia Skyways handles companion travel with care, and the senior coordinator reviews each plan for species, temperament, and comfort. If a cabin concern is reported, <<FACT F111>>. Keep all care notes and travel records ready, since clear details help the desk respond quickly and fairly.

Before you arrive, make sure carriers are secure, labels are easy to read, and water and comfort items are packed as allowed. If you need to submit a follow-up about a cabin overheating issue, <<FACT F117>>. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will guide you on the next steps and confirm what is needed for your case.

For steady service and simple support, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel.
